xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5447: Command palette conversation search stalls 15s+: synchronous vector scan, superseded searches keep running

plan.title: Command palette conversation search stalls 15s+: synchronous vector scan, superseded searches keep running
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every palette conversation search runs a synchronous 1.1-1.2 s sqlite-vec brute-force scan (plus up to 0.5 s BM25) on the dashboard main thread, the route ignores client disconnects so superseded keystroke searches run to completion and stack, BM25 waits for the query embedding, the embedding has no timeout, and the client never times out. Result: 15 s+ spinners, a 499 after 16.5 s, and /api/version stalling 4.8 s.
narratives.Proposal: Move BM25, vector and live-filter work into the existing dashboard DB worker on two new serial lanes (conversation-text, conversation-vector) whose waiters queue on the main thread and are dropped on abort; thread the Effect request signal from the palette route through runPaletteSearch, the service, the ranker and the embed call; start BM25 concurrently with a 2.5 s-bounded embedding; give each scan leg a 4 s deadline (live filter 2 s) that degrades to keyword + title results; run memory FTS and conversation search in parallel; add a 10 s palette client timeout with its own message. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-5447.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No ANN index, vector quantization, or reindex of embeddings.db
- No streaming/two-phase palette response and no new response fields marking degraded results
- No change to the semantic lane, searchSessionsSemantic, or its latest-wins cancellation
- No global latest-wins cancellation across clients (MCP, fleet peers, other tabs must not cancel each other)
- No worker termination as a cancellation mechanism
- No change to indexing (indexer.ts, conversation-search-watcher.ts)
- No new HTTP route, worker entry, tsdown entry, or desktop ENTRY_POINTS change
- No file-size allowlist edits

autoDecisions.summary: Scans run in the existing dashboard DB worker on two new lanes (conversation-text for BM25 + live filter, conversation-vector for the KNN scan)
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses proven worker plumbing that already loads sqlite-vec (poll lane); two lanes keep an unstoppable vector scan from delaying the next query's BM25; no build/desktop entry changes.

autoDecisions.summary: Waiting jobs on the two lanes queue on the main thread; abort removes waiters; in-flight scans run to completion; no worker termination
autoDecisions.rationale: The worker starts sync jobs inside its message handler so a cancel message cannot overtake a queued job; node:sqlite has no interrupt; terminate leaves the native scan running and reopens a 5.1 GB DB per burst.

autoDecisions.summary: Cancellation is per request signal, not global latest-wins
autoDecisions.rationale: The route also serves MCP search_conversations, fleet peers and other tabs, which must not cancel each other.

autoDecisions.summary: Query embedding 2,500 ms timeout; BM25 and vector legs 4,000 ms deadline; live filter 2,000 ms; client 10,000 ms
autoDecisions.rationale: Embedding measured 220-420 ms; scans 1.1-1.2 s warm; the server bound (~8.5 s) stays under the client timeout so the client sees degraded results rather than its timeout in the common slow case.

autoDecisions.summary: Embedding failure/timeout records a health failure and still returns BM25 + title rows; abort and scan deadlines record nothing
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the PAN-3771 banner meaningful (provider problems) without superseded keystrokes raising it.

autoDecisions.summary: Memory FTS and conversation search run concurrently in runPaletteSearch
autoDecisions.rationale: Memory FTS is already a worker; awaiting it first only adds latency.

autoDecisions.summary: Response shape unchanged; degraded results are not flagged to clients
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest change that fixes the stall; a degraded-mode indicator is a separate UX decision.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Add 4th parameter options {signal?: AbortSignal} to runDashboardDbJob. SERIAL_LANES = {'conversation-text','conversation-vector'}: post one job per lane at a time; keep waiters in a main-thread FIFO (laneWaiters) and track laneInFlight. In the worker message handler, clear laneInFlight and post the next live waiter for a final message BEFORE the `if (!job) return;` early return. Abort: delete from pending, remove from waiters, reject with signal.reason; lane stays busy until the worker answers. failPendingForLane clears both maps. Already-aborted signal rejects without posting. Inline Vitest path honors the signal. Never terminate a worker on abort. Add __testInternals.forceWorkerPath(enabled) (IC-1) so the test can drive a mocked spawnModuleWorker; fallback per PRD IC-1 is a real-worker test.

metadata.sizeJustification: One bug path (palette route -> search service -> ranker -> DB worker -> client). The 7 'subsystems' are inflated by colocated tests (tests/unit), docs and changelog.d; code changes span 4 modules on a single request path, 18 files total. Splitting the server-side fix from the client timeout would ship a client message for a stall the server still causes, or a server fix with no client bound; each item is still independently reviewable.
